interface.longDescription: When encountering an error, bug, or test failure that resists initial fix attempts — before proposing any fix, restate the error, scope the impact, enumerate possible causes, choose the minimal fix path, and define verification. Also: before formal output, apply first-principles scrutiny to user input — if logical flaws or cognitive biases are detected, point them out directly with actionable improvements. No flattery, no pandering, no avoidance.
